---
title: "Grouped quantitative panel displays"
output: html_document
---

This notebook groups saved quantitative outputs into display panels. It presents ASD-gene overlap counts, mean RNA expression, original bulk RNA values, differential-chromatin volcanoes, interval counts and the saved integration UMAP export. It does not fit new models or embeddings. Figure-specific counting units and biological sample identities are retained.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/common.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(patchwork))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE)
```

## Figure 6g schematic overlap counts

The original gene-set overlap statistics are represented schematically with the manuscript's pink/purple and green palette. Circle areas are not quantitative. The source analysis tested 175 ASD genes, which is distinct from the full 185-gene literature set printed in the artwork.

```{r figure-6g-schematic-overlap-counts-2}
plots <- list()
for (pop in c("VZ", "nonVZ")) {
  s <- read_table("Fig6_KC", paste0("6g_", pop, "_Statistics"))
  t <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 180)
  circ <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      x = cos(t),
      y = sin(t),
      Set = "RNA"
    ),
    data.frame(
      x = -1 + 0.38 * cos(t),
      y = -0.05 + 0.38 * sin(t),
      Set = "ASD"
    )
  )
  p <- ggplot(circ,
    aes(x, y, group = Set, fill = Set)) +
    geom_polygon(alpha = 0.8,
      color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(RNA = if (pop == "VZ") "#E49CB0" else "#A2A4CF",
      ASD = "#A4CEA0")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.1,
      y = 0,
      label = paste0(pop, " DE genes\nn=", s$DE_genes_P05),

      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -1.2,
      y = -0.65,
      label = paste0("ASD tested\nn=", s$ASD_genes_tested),

      size = 2.7
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -0.93,
      y = 0.55,
      label = paste0("Overlap n=", s$Observed_ASD_overlap),

      size = 2.8
    ) +
    coord_equal(
      xlim = c(-1.6, 1.3),
      ylim = c(-1.05, 1.05)
    ) +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")
  plots[[pop]] <- p
}
export_panel(
  wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1),
  "Fig6/6g_ASD_gene_overlap", 8, 3.5, note = "Schematic circle areas; original observed overlaps and tested gene universes; no new statistical test"
)
```

## Extended Figure 7 grouped expression panels

```{r extended-figure-7-grouped-expression-panels-3}
s <- read_table("Extended_Fig7_KC", "7ab_Cluster_RNA_summary")
for (g in c("Kdm6a", "Kdm6b")) {
  z <- s[s$Gene == g, ]
  z$Cluster <- factor(z$Cluster, levels = clusters)
  export_panel(
    ggplot(z, aes(Cluster, Mean_log_expression, group = 1)) +
      geom_line(color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      labs(
        title = paste(g, "mean expression"),
        x = NULL,
        y = "RNA log expression"
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7)),

    paste0("Ext7/7ab_mean_", g),
    5, 3
  )
}
d <- read_table("Extended_Fig7_KC", "7cde_jk_RPKM")
d$FlashTag_population <- factor(d$FlashTag_population,
  levels = c("FlashTagPositive", "FlashTagNegative"))
for (g in c("Kdm6a", "Kdm6b")) {
  z <- d[d$Gene == g, ]
  stopifnot(
    nrow(z) > 0
  )
  p <- ggplot(
    z, aes(
      factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "Mut")),
      RPKM, color = Genotype
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.06, height = 0, seed = 1),

      size = 1
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~FlashTag_population, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = MS$rna) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = "RPKM",
      title = g) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  fdr_labels <- unique(z[, c("FlashTag_population", "RNA_BH_FDR")])
  p <- p + geom_text(
    data = fdr_labels,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = sprintf("FDR = %.3g", RNA_BH_FDR)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 2.5,
    color = ifelse(fdr_labels$RNA_BH_FDR < 0.05, "#448844", "#D84E4A")
  )
  export_panel(
    p, paste0("Ext7/7cd_RPKM_", g),
    5, 3
  )
}
display_genes <- c("Kdm6b", "Tbr1", "Slc17a6", "Bcl11b", "Neurod2", "Nrxn2")
z <- d[d$Gene %in% display_genes, ]
z$Gene <- factor(z$Gene, levels = display_genes)
# Each gene has its own shared FTpos/FTneg Y axis, as in the manuscript.
gene_panels <- lapply(display_genes, function(gene) {
  q <- z[z$Gene == gene, ]
  q$Population <- factor(q$FlashTag_population,
    levels = c("FlashTagPositive", "FlashTagNegative"),
    labels = c("FTpos", "FTneg"))
  q$Genotype <- factor(q$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "Mut"))
  p <- ggplot(q, aes(Genotype, RPKM, color = Genotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.65) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Sex), position = position_jitter(width = 0.045, height = 0, seed = 1), size = 1.4) +
    facet_grid(~Population) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MS$rna) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(F = 16, M = 17)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(WT = "WT", Mut = "cKO")) +
    labs(title = gene, x = NULL, y = "RPKM") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.6, "mm"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10), axis.title = element_text(size = 11))
  stopifnot(nrow(ggplot_build(p)$data[[1]]) == 4,
    nrow(ggplot_build(p)$data[[2]]) == nrow(q))
  p
})
export_panel(wrap_plots(gene_panels, nrow = 1),
  "Ext7/7e_RPKM_strip", 17, 3.3,
  note = "Six gene blocks; FTpos then FTneg with a shared Y axis within each gene; all 90 observations retained")
for (gene in c("Tle4", "Tbr1")) {
  z <- d[d$Gene == gene, ]
  p <- ggplot(z, aes(factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "Mut")), RPKM, color = Genotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.65) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.06, height = 0, seed = 1), size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~FlashTag_population, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MS$rna) +
    labs(title = gene, x = NULL, y = "RPKM") +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
  export_panel(p, paste0("Ext7/", if (gene == "Tle4") "7j_Tle4_RPKM" else "7k_Tbr1_RPKM"), 1.6, 3.3)
}
```

## Extended Figure 8 volcano grid

```{r extended-figure-8-volcano-grid-4}
pp <- list()
# Manuscript order: FlashTag-negative above FlashTag-positive.
# Keep one X range within each assay and one Y range across all six panels.
assays <- c(atac = "ATAC", ac = "H3K27ac", me3 = "H3K27me3")
all_tables <- lapply(names(assays), function(a) {
  lapply(c("FTneg", "FTpos"), function(ft) {
    read_table("Extended_Fig8_KC", paste0("8e_", a, "_", ft))
  })
})
names(all_tables) <- names(assays)
ymax <- max(vapply(unlist(all_tables, recursive = FALSE),
  function(d) max(d$neg_log10_P, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1)))
ymax <- max(20, ceiling(ymax / 5) * 5)
for (ft in c("FTneg", "FTpos")) for (a in names(assays)) {
  d <- all_tables[[a]][[match(ft, c("FTneg", "FTpos"))]]
  xmax <- max(abs(unlist(lapply(all_tables[[a]], function(x) x$Signed_log2FC))), na.rm = TRUE)
  xmax <- ceiling(xmax)
  p <- volcano(d) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xmax, xmax), ylim = c(0, ymax), expand = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ymax, by = 5)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey55") +
    labs(title = paste(assays[[a]], ft),
      x = "Signed log2 fold change", y = "-log10(P value)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10), axis.title = element_text(size = 11))
  stopifnot(nrow(ggplot_build(p)$data[[1]]) == nrow(d))
  pp[[paste(a, ft)]] <- p
}
export_panel(wrap_plots(pp, ncol = 3), "Ext8/8e_six_volcanoes", 10, 7,
  note = "FTneg above FTpos; ATAC, H3K27ac, H3K27me3 left to right; common Y scale and assay-specific shared X limits; no rows clipped")

```

## Extended Figure 1 absolute differential counts

The manuscript displays counts, not fractions. Use the saved per-module counts with explicit comparison labels. The module colors follow the manuscript's yellow/intermediate blue/red/grey grouping.

```{r extended-figure-1-absolute-differential-counts-5}
module_cols <- function(u) {
  n <- as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", u))
  maxn <- max(n)
  cols <- rep("#969696", length(u))
  cols[n <= 3] <- colorRampPalette(c("#FBD602", "#CDAB2C", "#9B9A00"))(3)[n[n <=
    3]]
  mid <- n > 3 & n <= 11
  cols[mid] <- colorRampPalette(c("#62B876", "#44B1CB", "#5899C8"))(8)[n[mid] -
    3]
  late <- n > 11 & n <= 15
  cols[late] <- colorRampPalette(c("#F0644C", "#AE2424"))(4)[n[late] -
    11]
  setNames(cols, u)
}
for (s in c("1e_DiffBind_counts", "1f_DiffBind_counts", "1g_DiffBind_counts")) {
  if (s %in% c("1f_DiffBind_counts", "1g_DiffBind_counts")) {
    plot_ext1_differential_counts(s)
    next
  }
  d <- read_table("Extended_Fig1_KC", s)
  d$Comparison <- factor(d$Comparison, levels = unique(d$Comparison))
  d$Module <- factor(d$Module, levels = module_order(d$Module))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Comparison, Significant_interval_count, fill = Module)) +
    geom_col() + scale_fill_manual(values = module_cols(levels(d$Module))) +
    labs(x = NULL,
      y = "Significant intervals") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, size = 6),

      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),

      legend.key.size = grid::unit(2, "mm")
    )
  export_panel(
    p, paste0("Ext1/", s),
    8, 5
  )
}
```

## Saved Extended Figure 6 UMAP export

This original vector export is loaded directly. No UMAP embedding or reclustering is rerun.

```{r saved-extended-figure-6-umap-export-6}
for (ext in c("pdf", "png")) stopifnot(
  file.copy(
    file.path(
      REPO, "objects/plot_checkpoints", paste0("Ext_Data_Fig_6_Selected_bundle_UMAPs_no_legend.", ext)
    ),
    file.path(REPO, "panels/Ext6", paste0("6b_saved_UMAPs.", ext)),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
)
panel_registry[["Ext6/6b_saved_UMAPs"]] <- data.frame(
  panel = "Ext6/6b_saved_UMAPs",
  note = "Original saved selected-bundle UMAP vector export; no reclustering",

  width = NA_real_,
  height = NA_real_
)
finish_notebook("10")
sessionInfo()
```
